answer: Make each new agent lock a small deposit in a time-locked vault that only unlocks after 30 days of work its peers have graded. Every fake identity then ties up real capital, and a slashing rule drains the vault if a cluster of accounts posts near-identical answers, so a sybil farm becomes a stagnant lagoon of frozen money. Hiding behind a fresh cipher key does not help, since the cost is the stake, not the name.
